d: Chestnut brown hair flows past the shoulders with wispy bangs and side-swept locks, paired with animal ears of the same color and white inner fur. The eyes are a muted grey with a calm, neutral expression on a youthful, mature face. The build is slender with a curvy bust, dressed in a white short-sleeved top with a high collar and black straps, worn under a white oversized coat, paired with tight black glossy pants featuring yellow accent tags. A glowing yellow cubic pendant hangs from a black cord around the neck.
